VirtualHost configuration:
*:443                  is a NameVirtualHost
         default server example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/example.com.conf:12)
         port 443 namevhost example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/example.com.conf:12)
                 alias www.example.com
         port 443 namevhost shop.example.org (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/shop.example.org.conf:1)
                 wild alias *.shop.example.org
*:80                   is a NameVirtualHost
         default server web-01.example.net (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf:1)
         port 80 namevhost web-01.example.net (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf:1)
         port 80 namevhost example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/example.com.conf:1)
                 alias www.example.com
